subcategory_text: Assets are prioritized based on classification, criticality, resources, and impact on the mission
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: RA-02, RA-03, RA-09
ISO/IEC 27001:2022: Annex A.5.9, Annex A.5.12, Annex A.5.13
CRI Profile v2.0: ID.AM-05, ID.AM-05.01, ID.AM-05.02
implementation_examples: Define criteria for prioritizing each class of assets
Apply the prioritization criteria to assets
Track the asset priorities and update them periodically or when significant changes to the organization occur
assessment_objectives: Determine whether assets are prioritized based on classification, criticality, resources, and impact on the mission.
Determine whether activities are conducted to define criteria for prioritizing each class of assets.
Determine whether activities are conducted to apply the prioritization criteria to assets.
Determine whether implementation outcomes are monitored, evaluated, and documented.
